frequency_notice: Official fatality statistics are published periodically. This dashboard checks for updated data weekly; the underlying figures are not necessarily weekly.

status_vocabulary.final: Published by the source as final.

status_vocabulary.estimated: Flagged by the source as estimated (e).
status_vocabulary.missing: No value published by the source for this period. Shown as a gap, never as zero.
status_vocabulary.unknown: Published without a status flag; finality cannot be established from the source.

targets.name: EU 2030 road-death benchmark (fatality component)
targets.policy_reference: EU Road Safety Policy Framework 2021-2030 – Next steps towards 'Vision Zero' (SWD(2019) 283)
targets.note: The EU objective is to halve both road deaths and serious injuries by 2030 compared with 2019. This benchmark covers road deaths only and does not by itself measure the serious-injury objective. Vision Zero is the long-term ambition of moving close to zero road deaths by 2050.
